Various generalizations and analogues of the Thue-Siegel-Dyson theorem are known, and it seems probable that the method of the present paper will lead to improvements in many such results. Certainly this is the case for all the results in Siegel's basic memoir‡, one of the most important of which concerns approximation to an algebraic number by algebraic numbers of given degree.
